_comment: Feeds the aggregator reads. Every URL here was checked and returned items
on 2026-09-01; a feed that starts failing is reported by name at the end of
each fetch rather than failing the run.
weight  1-3, how much this outlet's byline is worth before keywords.
It is a tiebreaker, not a verdict: a 1 with the right headline
outranks a 3 with the wrong one.
enabled optional, defaults true. Set false to mute a feed without
losing the URL.
Breaking Bourbon has no feed of any kind (checked /feed, /rss.xml and
Squarespace's ?format=rss — all 404). It is the one site worth opening by
hand each week; see news/README.md.
The Google News rows are queries, not outlets. They cast the wide net that
catches a local paper reporting a distillery expansion. Their links point
at Google's redirector, so those items are flagged needsDirectLink and
cannot reach an issue until you paste the publisher's own URL.
PR Newswire is the wire the brands themselves file on — the same source the
bourbon-media skill pulls press photos from — so a release lands here before
any outlet rewrites it, with the brand's own numbers in it. Read it for what
it is: a press release is a primary source for what a brand announced and
what it says a bottle costs. It is not a source for whether that is a good
price. That verdict is the site's job, not the wire's.
Only the beers-wines-and-spirits and product-recalls categories are worth
polling. PR Newswire's other category feeds, including food-beverages,
silently fall back to all-industry news — checked 2026-09-01, and they came
back full of bank earnings.
